ar: وَعَنِ التَّابِعِيْنَ لَهُمْ بِإِحْسَانٍ إِلَى يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ وَ احْشُرْنَا وَ ارْحَمْنَا مَعَهُمْ بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ . يَا اَللّٰهُ . يَا حَيُّ . يَا قَيُّوْمُ . لَآ إِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ . يَا اَللّٰهُ . يَا رَبَّنَا . يَا وَاسِعَ الْمَغْفِرَةِ . يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ . اَللّٰهُمَّ آمِيْنَ
tr: Wa `ani ‘t-Tābi`īna la hum bi iḥsānin ilā Yawmi ‘d-Dīni, Wa ‘ḥshurnā wa ‘rḥamnā ma`ahum bi Raḥmati ka Yā Arḥam ‘r-Rāḥimīna. Yā Allāh, Yā Ḥayyu, Yā Qayyūm. Lā ilāha illā ant. Yā Allāh, Yā Rabbanā, Yā Wāsi` ‘l-Maghfirah, Yā Arḥama ‘r-Rāhimīna, Allāhumma Āmīn.
en: and those who follow them in goodness until the Day of Judgement! And gather us and have mercy upon us with them, by Your Mercy, O Most Merciful of The Profoundly Merciful! O Allah! O Living, Self-Sustaining! There is no god but You! O Allah! O our Lord! O Vast in Forgiveness! O Most Merciful of The Profoundly Merciful!
blocks.review: The dot before the red اَللّٰهُمَّ آمِيْنَ is also printed red.
